risk_note: H5 invite page /invite (apps/h5 pages/invite, routes.ts, texts/invite.ts; display only, no money logic). Finalized spec design/specs/app-invite-share.md (App hi-fi batch 3); contract getMyInvite (implemented) and the invite section of getConfig read through the bridge app.getConfig. Invite code card with copy code / copy link / save poster (preview via media.previewImage, save via media.saveImage, album denial notice, no save while poster_url is null); invited count card linking to Ledger; rule card whose last item is the no-reward sentence only while the reward is off; reward card only while invite.reward_enabled (amount by BR-TEXT-10); unavailable state with a contact button (cs.open, no account identifiers) and the rule card; 30413 / 10005 / offline / load failure; dark mode; placeholder before any hook when no API client (frozen h5-shell route test). Route adds about 8.5 KiB gzip, initial plus route about 138 KiB of the 150 KiB budget. Known gap reported: help_links has no keys for the two rule articles, so their ids are fixed in the page until the contract adds them. Rule tests written by an independent Claude in three calls (Codex out of quota until 2026-10-30; ledger tester claude-independent, approvals id 36); Claude spec-test review r3 pass; red on the test machine (red/3: 38 red, 0 problems). Implementation by Opus 5.5; test machine verify-fast/3 and browser/2 green. Adversarial review by a fresh independent Claude (tools/agent/claude-run.sh). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass, two S2 (fixed help article ids until the contract adds help_links keys; a live campaign without an amount is shown as off) tracked in followups; independent Claude because Codex hit its usage limit until 2026-10-30

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 fail (2 S1: config must come through the bridge app.getConfig, the bridge whitelist lacked app.getConfig and cs.open; 3 S2) plus a red/1 load error, round 2 fail (1 S1: the rule card helper found only the title row), round 3 pass; the tests were written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)
